[We are Novolex]

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

[We are Novolex]

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

After extensive research on how we were going to best update our packaging away from foam while
maintaining a quality product with good value we landed on Clover. This packaging gives us a high
end modern look while providing us with the value we need to keep our prices fair for our guests. We
have been able to use the Clover packaging across our group that ranges from fast casual Wing Shack
and Sexy Sammie’s to our new full service and more upscale Centennial Public House. The venting
works very well, even when stacked as some other vented containers seal themselves in when stacked.

Brian Seifried

Centennial Hospitality Group

Genpak’s Made in America and their quality, we love supporting America companies and the Texas
Takeout container sets it all off. It’s just a quality product. I suggest giving Genpak a try
because we have found this to be the best quality out there. I suggest giving it a try being a Texas
man.

Jaret Casteal

The Hog Pen, Leakey, TX

Mercy Chefs would like to give Genpak a great big thank you for their support and gift of clam
shells, picnic packs, bowls with lids, cups, etc. The list goes on! These products were used to
serve the victims of hurricane Isaac in LaPlace and Slidell Louisiana. Companies like Genpak make it
possible for us to serve in disaster situations. Mercy Chefs thanks you and the 35,000 folks served
thank you!

Debbie Lowe

Mercy Chefs, Portsmouth, VA

I contacted Genpak to check on prices for cone paper cups for our school’s students. I was promptly
given a phone number for a local representative; very nice to have someone answer the phone in
person! The representative, R. Sherrod, could not help me with a purchase, but he talked to me for
about 10 minutes with suggestions for using local companies that may carry the supplies I was
looking for. I will most certainly keep his number in my phone and will use Genpak if I ever have a
need. Amazing customer service!!!

Lisa Hunt

San Jose Elementary School, Dunedin, FL

We at Wingstop value our Partnership like relationship with Genpak. They are very responsive and
attentive to our needs.

Dave McDonald

Wingstop Restaurants, Inc., Richardson, TX

I have used Genpak packaging in several companies I have worked at. The product works great, the
ability to have the product embossed, really helps with branding.

David Foulke

Miami Subs, Miami, GL

We’ve been working with the Genpak team for several years. Don and his team do a great job of taking
great care of our account. Thank you for the great service.

Ricardo Baez

Don Pancho Authentic Mexican, Salem

I have been selling Genpak products for over 35 years. Over this time I have found that Genpak is
the best foam dinner tray on the market. It has been a pleasure working with Genpak for so many
years. Before Genpak came into our market, all we had was paper plates for take out dinners. It has
been a great 35 years doing business with them.

Stewart Driggers

Berkeley Paper Co Inc, Moncks Corner, SC

## Sustainability

We believe in sustainability, so much that it is part of our company mission and vision. Our
sustainability initiatives can be found throughout our facilities from electricity savings to water
recycling. Our most impactful program is our EcoStar® post-consumer recycled material, that is made
of 75% or more recycled content.

## Innovation

Our award winning team brings design elements to each project that utilize unique tool designs,
intricate trim features and achieve elegant functionality from simple open and closing, to

### THE SUSTAINABLE SOLUTION

It may surprise you to learn that not only is recycled plastic sustainable, but it’s *the*
sustainable solution. Provided it already exists, that is. That’s why we use 100% recycled and
recyclable HDPE, so we can reuse the plastic we already have indefinitely.

### WHAT IS HDPE?

HDPE stands for high-density polyethylene, the same material used to make milk jugs. HDPE is strong,
sturdy, flexible,        non-toxic and food safe. It is one of the most widely collected and
recycled materials and is indefinitely recyclable. After extensive testing and for the reasons
above, PakTech chose 100% recycled and recyclable HDPE as the preferred material    for their
sustainable packaging handles. Our recycled content is certified by SCS Global Services.

### THE SUSTAINABLE SOLUTION

It may surprise you to learn that not only is recycled plastic sustainable, but it’s *the*
sustainable solution. Provided it already exists, that is. That’s why we use 100% recycled and
recyclable HDPE, so we can reuse the plastic we already have indefinitely.

### WHAT IS HDPE?

HDPE stands for high-density polyethylene, the same material used to make milk jugs. HDPE is strong,
sturdy, flexible,        non-toxic and food safe. It is one of the most widely collected and
recycled materials and is indefinitely recyclable. After extensive testing and for the reasons
above, PakTech chose 100% recycled and recyclable HDPE as the preferred material    for their
sustainable packaging handles. Our recycled content is certified by SCS Global Services.

# Welcome to Algoa Plastics  |  Established 1994

## Manufacturers and Distributors of Plastic and Packaging Materials

Algoa Plastics is located in 6th Avenue, Newton Park, where they have introduced their new retail
packaging section - "THE PACKAGING WAREHOUSE."

 

Besides still concentrating on our initial core business of flexible packaging, we have also grown
our product range to include a vast range of new packaging products.

 

We are particularly excited about our growing range of **earth-friendly** products which include:

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
* The Baobab range of Biodegradable Plastic bags;                                                   
* Bio-compostable Cups and Tubs made from plant starch;                                             
* Meal Boxes and Containers made from sugar cane;                                                   
* Our range of Paper Products such as Paper Bags and Boxes harvested from sustainable forests;      
* Biodegradable and Paper Straws;                                                                   
* A range of wood packaging made from Birchwood and Bamboo.                                         
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 

Please feel free to visit us or contact us to arrange for one of our representatives to visit you to
discuss your Biodegradable packaging options.

### [Wooden Soap Dishes][80]

[ View more Wood Products ][81]

## Why Choose Bamboo Wood Art?

### Factory Direct – Competitive Pricing

As a direct manufacturer, we eliminate unnecessary middlemen, offering better margins for our
clients and reliable delivery.

### Sustainable Materials

We use 100% natural bamboo and FSC-certified wood. Our production practices are low-impact and
focused on environmental responsibility.

### OEM/ODM & Customization

From logo engraving to packaging design, we support full customization services to match your
brand’s identity and market.

### Bulk Orders & Global Shipping

We are equipped to fulfill large volume orders and ship worldwide. Whether you're ordering 1,000
toothbrushes or 20,000 bamboo baskets, our production line ensures quality and consistency.

### Quality Assurance

Each product undergoes strict quality control at every stage — from raw material selection to final
packaging. Our goal is to exceed your expectations.

## Serving Global Markets

Our bamboo and wooden products are exported across North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and
Oceania. Our clients include:
* Eco product distributors
* Zero-waste and sustainable lifestyle brands
* Supermarket chains and retailers
* Amazon, Shopify, and other e-commerce sellers
* Hospitality & spa industry suppliers

We understand the international market’s requirements for certifications, packaging, and compliance.
We’re here to ensure a seamless, professional experience from inquiry to delivery.

[Latest News and Blog Highlights]

## Customer Testimonials

We are proud to work with global partners who value quality and sustainability. Here’s what some of
our satisfied clients have to say:
[Customer Testimonials Section]

[ Get Best Quote ][82]

## FAQ

Do you support OEM or private label orders?
Yes. We offer full OEM/ODM support including product design, logo engraving, packaging, and
labeling.
What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
MOQ depends on the product type. For most items, we offer flexible MOQs starting from 500–1000 pcs.
For stock items or repeat orders, MOQs can be lower.
Can I request samples before placing a bulk order?
Absolutely. Sample orders are available and can be customized. We usually ship samples within 5–7
days.
What is your typical lead time for production?
For bulk orders, the production lead time is usually 25–35 days depending on quantity and
customization requirements.
What materials do you use? Are they sustainable?
We use 100% natural bamboo and certified sustainable wood. Our materials are eco-friendly,
renewable, and biodegradable.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes, we export worldwide. We work with reliable freight partners to ship by sea, air, or courier,
depending on your needs.
Can I visit your factory?
Yes, we welcome client visits. Our factory is located in Fujian, China. Please contact us to arrange
a visit or a virtual tour.
Do your products meet international standards?
Yes, our products comply with international quality and safety standards. Certifications such as
FSC, LFGB, or FDA can be provided upon request.

## Let’s Create Natural Value Together

If you’re searching for a reliable partner to supply high-quality bamboo and wooden products in
bulk, Bamboo Wood Art is your trusted choice. We’re not just a factory — we’re artisans of nature,
combining tradition with innovation.

Contact us today to request a catalog, get a quote, or discuss your custom project.

Featured Initiatives

## Our students are turning school cafeterias into youth action hubs.

At Cafeteria Culture (CafCu), we ignite student leadership to drive real-world change—starting in
the school cafeteria, where every student has equal access. Since 2009, our hands-on programs have
empowered youth in frontline communities to tackle food waste and plastic pollution through science,
civic action, media, and art, while exploring local composting to increase local resilience.

Our 2024-2025 impact report reveals how student leadership is transforming school cafeterias:

Featured Initiatives

## Our students are turning school cafeterias into youth action hubs.

At Cafeteria Culture (CafCu), we ignite student leadership to drive real-world change—starting in
the school cafeteria, where every student has equal access. Since 2009, our hands-on programs have
empowered youth in frontline communities to tackle food waste and plastic pollution through science,
civic action, media, and art, while exploring local composting to increase local resilience.

### Buying from Chinese Factories and need a Shipping Agent?

# CNXtrans will receive your goods and ship together internationally for you by Air, Sea or Land

[- ][25][Get our China warehouse address ][26]and give it to all the factories/suppliers that you're
buying from

- Enjoy free storage (for 2 months), repackaging & consolidation of packages at our warehouse to
minimize freight costs before shipping internationally

- We can ship to you, your customers or warehouses and fulfillment centers around the world
(including [Amazon FBA Warehouses][27])

[Get Our Warehouse Address Now][28]

#### What is CNXtrans?

[Container Freight Shipping from China]

#### CNXtrans is a comprehensive international logistics and freight forwarding service enabling
#### businesses and individuals all over the world to import & ship internationally from China. We
#### offer warehousing, consolidation, repackaging and international shipping from China via air,
#### sea or land.
####  
#### Goods from multiple suppliers whether from [Alibaba][29] or other platforms can be consolidated
#### at our warehouses before shipping internationally from China to you, your customers or
#### warehouses and fulfillment centers (including [Amazon FBA warehouses)][30] around the world.
#### Whether you're shipping a small package via air courier express (DHL, FedEx, UPS etc.) or
#### multiple large containers by sea, feel free to contact us at [contact@cnxtrans.com][31] to
#### enquire about your logistical needs. We'll help you figure out the best way to ship.

#### Ship from China Smartly

## 3 SIMPLE STEPS

## 1. BUY FROM ONE OR MULTIPLE SUPPLIERS

[Warehousing in China for storage & consolidation before international shipping - CNXtrans]

## 2. SEND ALL GOODS TO OUR WAREHOUSE IN CHINA

## 3. SHIP INTERNATIONALLY

1. Get Our Warehouse Address - click [here][32]
2. Give our warehouse address to each factory/supplier you're buyingS from. Or, if you're buying
   from Taobao, use our warehouse address when checking out on Taobao.
3. Every domestic shipment in China comes with a unique Domestic Shipment Number (运单号). Record
   the domestic shipment number for each domestic shipment you get sent to our warehouse. If you're
   buying from multiple suppliers, you can wait till you have the full list of domestic shipment
   numbers ready before sending the final list to us. We will use the domestic shipment numbers to
   match the corresponding packages at our warehouse to your account.
4. Once you're ready to ship, we'll consolidate all your packages and process them for international
   shipping. We can ship to you, your customers or even [Amazon FBA warehouses][33] around the
   world. CNXtrans offers [international shipping ][34]from China to more than 200 countries
   worldwide via air, sea or land. 

[Get Our Warehouse Address Now][35]

#### Ship by Air, Sea or Train

#### Ship from China via air, sea or rail depending on the nature of your shipment. Note that
#### shipping by train is only available for shipments to European countries.

###### Air Shipping/Freight

[[Ship by Air]][36]

###### Ocean Shipping/Freight

[[Ship by Sea Freight]][37]

###### Train Shipping/Rail Freight

[[Ship by Rail Freight]][38]

For smaller shipments and even larger shipments where your priority is speed, we ship via air
courier/cargo. Air courier shipments via DHL, FedEx, UPS, TNT or SF Express can be delivered to you
or your customers' doorsteps in as quickly as 3-5 business days. For larger shipments we can also
ship by air cargo (via commercial airlines). We also have bulk air shipping routes (for large
shipments) to USA, Canada, UK & all of Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Japan, Vietnam,
Thailand, Malaysia & Singapore that are inclusive of customs clearance and delivery to door
([including Amazon FBA warehouses][39] around the world).

For larger shipments especially if you're shipping in pallets or containers, we can ship to you via
ocean freight. Note that ocean shipments are measured in terms of Cubic Meters

# This is not packaging-

### It's the world's first

### commercially scaled bio-foam.

[ Cruz Foam™ ][27]
[ Get In Touch ][28]

## Award-Winning Sustainability

As TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative in 2024, and one of the only
Lomi-Approved packaging materials, Cruz Foam is setting the bar for sustainability and is scaled at
cost as a replacement to EPE. We provide cost competitiveness and get it to you within our existing
network. So you can protect the items you ship and let the packaging gracefully disintegrate after
use, like it naturally should.

[Degradation of Cruz Foam]

## Working With Global Partners
* [ Expert packaging network creating solutions for you ][29]
* Replaces your EPS and EPE with Cruz Foam
* Enables existing producers and converters a
  frictionless transition
* Works with all foam conversion platforms and
  replaces your existing foam

[ Become a Partner ][30]
[Cruz Foam sheets on Pallets]

## Stories of Sustainability

[ View More Stories ][31]
Play Video
If you bring a great product to market but wrap it in something that is not environmentally
responsible- it unravels a lot of the good that you did in the first place. Cruz Foam far surpassed
the performance of the material that we are using currently- so not only does it allow us to have a
better environmental footprint, we can get our product to our customers with ground shipping, less
dry ice, less cost, a lower carbon footprint, and a greater unboxing experience.
[Phill Groves]

#### Phil Graves

## Packaging Tray Information

DEFINITIONS:
* **Packaging Trays** are plastic trays made from durable low cost materials such as PVC, PETG, and
  Styrene. The thermoform trays include cavities sized to fit the component part which is being
  packaged. When properly designed, the tray cavities protect the component in transit if shipped by
  a parcel service in a box, or if shipped in larger quantities on a skid.
* **Thermoform Trays** are plastic trays made from the thermoforming process.  Plastic thermoforming
  is a low cost process to form thin gauge plastic into shapes. The trays are one type of
  thermoformed packaging.
* **Thermoform Packaging** uses the thermoform process to build plastic trays, plastic clamshells,
  and plastic end caps for part protection. Thermoform packaging generally works along with a
  corrugated box for part protection.

## Packaging Tray Information

DEFINITIONS:
* **Packaging Trays** are plastic trays made from durable low cost materials such as PVC, PETG, and
  Styrene. The thermoform trays include cavities sized to fit the component part which is being
  packaged. When properly designed, the tray cavities protect the component in transit if shipped by
  a parcel service in a box, or if shipped in larger quantities on a skid.
* **Thermoform Trays** are plastic trays made from the thermoforming process.  Plastic thermoforming
  is a low cost process to form thin gauge plastic into shapes. The trays are one type of
  thermoformed packaging.
* **Thermoform Packaging** uses the thermoform process to build plastic trays, plastic clamshells,
  and plastic end caps for part protection. Thermoform packaging generally works along with a
  corrugated box for part protection.

Application

EPS packaging is one of the big applications of Expanded polystyrene (EPS), from Major appliance
packaging to small household appliance packaging, different kinds of EPS box etc.

[EPS Construction]

## EPS Construction

Application

Expanded polystyrene (EPS) is a highly versatile material for construction application from Geofoam,
Light weight 3D panel, ICF block. EPS sandwich panel, EPS hourdis, and decking,     etc.

[EPS Insulation]

## EPS Insulation

Application

One of EPS major application is thermal insulation, it can be used in EPS roof insulation, EPS wall
insulation, EPS underfloor insulation, both easy and safe to use and water-resistant.

[EPS Insulation]

## EPS Decoration

Application

EPS decoration and EPS coating can be both apply in interior and exterior by CNC cutting machine or
moulded, It can be mainly used in door pocket, window pocket, cornier, ceiling decoration.

[EPS Agriculture]

## EPS Agriculture

Application

The biggest EPS application in agriculture was

the EPS seeding tray: Applying seedling nurseries for hydroponics.

Another application is the EPS flower pot.

## EPS Packaging

Application

EPS packaging is one of the big applications of Expanded polystyrene (EPS), from Major appliance
packaging to small household appliance packaging, different kinds of EPS box etc.

[EPS Construction]

## EPS Construction

Application

Expanded polystyrene (EPS) is a highly versatile material for construction application from Geofoam,
Light weight 3D panel, ICF block. EPS sandwich panel, EPS hourdis, and decking,     etc.

[EPS Insulation]

## EPS Insulation

Application

One of EPS major application is thermal insulation, it can be used in EPS roof insulation, EPS wall
insulation, EPS underfloor insulation, both easy and safe to use and water-resistant.

[EPS Insulation]

## EPS Decoration

Application

EPS decoration and EPS coating can be both apply in interior and exterior by CNC cutting machine or
moulded, It can be mainly used in door pocket, window pocket, cornier, ceiling decoration.

[EPS Agriculture]

## EPS Agriculture

Application

The biggest EPS application in agriculture was

the EPS seeding tray: Applying seedling nurseries for hydroponics.

Another application is the EPS flower pot.

Meet ESI's Favorite Packaging Features

For some inspiration, take a look at some of the fun titles we’ve made!
Remember, everything can be changed and customized to your own needs.

#### [Thick Chipboard & Book Binding][172]

Chipboard- the magic ingredient that makes a box, LP, or a book rigid.
The core material works behind the scenes and is never seen.
Chipboard is wrapped with either a printed paper and laminated, or a special material like linen or
leather.
[More info ][173]

#### [Organic Packaging][174]

We offer all kinds of organic, eco-friendly options such as recycled paper, unbleached fiberboard,
reclaimed pulp material, uncoated varnish free papers, vegetable based inks, and plastic
alternatives such as recycled paper trays.
[More info ][175]

#### [Embossing & Debossing][176]

Embossing is raised relief. Debossing is indented.
Not only can you see it, you can feel it. It is a tactile way to accent a figure, logo, or title.
[More info ][177]

#### [Uncoated Matte Paper][178]

A great way to do a vintage look. Uncoated papers are soft and somewhat absorbant, inherently matte.
[More info ][179]

#### [Linen Wrap][180]

Fabrics are fantastic for a textile, old school approach. You can do simple 1C black silkscreening
or a foil stamp….just like the old books.
[More info ][181]

#### [Foil Stamping][182]

Hot Foil Stamping is available in a multitude of colors. If you want to give your title the ultimate
sparkle, then this is the effect.
[More info ][183]

#### [Books & Notebooks][184]

We do all kinds of books; hardbound coffee table books, softcover, spiral notebooks, glossy photo
books, spiral bound, vellum flip books, and more.
If the book has enough pages, we can do perfect binding which gives the book that nice spine.
[More info ][185]

#### [Slipcase Sets][186]

Slipcase sets use a slipcase to bundle items such as books or volumes together. Options for tube
style or side-loading.
[More info ][187]

#### [Die Cut Packaging][188]

Customize your packaging with die cut shapes, dimensions, holes, squiggles, lettering and what-nots.
[More info ][189]

#### [Spot Gloss & Matte Lamination][190]

Spot UV Gloss – High impact shiny spot area of gloss ink, UV cured.
Pair it with a velvety soft-touch matte lamination.
[More info ][191]

#### [OBI, Ribbons, Magnets & More][192]

We love the extra touches. Add a ribbon? Sure. We also offer Magnets & Velcro for closure. Closure
that’s fun? Imagine that.
[More info ][193]

#### [Kraft Paper][194]

Black or Tan kraft paper….nubby, classic, fun., like an old album or a scrapbook.
Kraft paper makes the perfect inside lining or a sleeve. We love old school.
[More info ][195]

Meet ESI's Favorite Packaging Features

For some inspiration, take a look at some of the fun titles we’ve made!
Remember, everything can be changed and customized to your own needs.

#### [Thick Chipboard & Book Binding][172]

Chipboard- the magic ingredient that makes a box, LP, or a book rigid.
The core material works behind the scenes and is never seen.
Chipboard is wrapped with either a printed paper and laminated, or a special material like linen or
leather.
[More info ][173]

#### [Organic Packaging][174]

We offer all kinds of organic, eco-friendly options such as recycled paper, unbleached fiberboard,
reclaimed pulp material, uncoated varnish free papers, vegetable based inks, and plastic
alternatives such as recycled paper trays.
[More info ][175]

#### [Embossing & Debossing][176]

Embossing is raised relief. Debossing is indented.
Not only can you see it, you can feel it. It is a tactile way to accent a figure, logo, or title.
[More info ][177]

#### [Uncoated Matte Paper][178]

A great way to do a vintage look. Uncoated papers are soft and somewhat absorbant, inherently matte.
[More info ][179]

#### [Linen Wrap][180]

Fabrics are fantastic for a textile, old school approach. You can do simple 1C black silkscreening
or a foil stamp….just like the old books.
[More info ][181]

#### [Foil Stamping][182]

Hot Foil Stamping is available in a multitude of colors. If you want to give your title the ultimate
sparkle, then this is the effect.
[More info ][183]

#### [Books & Notebooks][184]

We do all kinds of books; hardbound coffee table books, softcover, spiral notebooks, glossy photo
books, spiral bound, vellum flip books, and more.
If the book has enough pages, we can do perfect binding which gives the book that nice spine.
[More info ][185]

#### [Slipcase Sets][186]

Slipcase sets use a slipcase to bundle items such as books or volumes together. Options for tube
style or side-loading.
[More info ][187]

#### [Die Cut Packaging][188]

Customize your packaging with die cut shapes, dimensions, holes, squiggles, lettering and what-nots.
[More info ][189]

#### [Spot Gloss & Matte Lamination][190]

Spot UV Gloss – High impact shiny spot area of gloss ink, UV cured.
Pair it with a velvety soft-touch matte lamination.
[More info ][191]

#### [OBI, Ribbons, Magnets & More][192]

We love the extra touches. Add a ribbon? Sure. We also offer Magnets & Velcro for closure. Closure
that’s fun? Imagine that.
[More info ][193]

#### [Kraft Paper][194]

Black or Tan kraft paper….nubby, classic, fun., like an old album or a scrapbook.
Kraft paper makes the perfect inside lining or a sleeve. We love old school.
[More info ][195]

high-quality products and materials at [wholesale foam][46] prices! Whether you’re a business trying
to find a low-cost, hassle-free foam material supplier, or an individual on a quest for great prices
on premium foam materials, Foam Factory has just what you’ve been looking for.

With Foam Factory’s wholesale pricing, what you see is what you get. This is great for small
businesses and upholstery shops looking for a bulk supplier, because every penny counts and being
able to accurately budget keeps things running smoothly. The last thing any company wants is to
receive an invoice with extra pop-up fees because of services or charges that were only mentioned
after the fact. Without tiered pricing, you’ll never have to buy more than you need to get the best
deal on an item either, whether you’re ordering 1 or 100. Individual customers are welcome to take
advantage of our wholesale pricing as well. There’s no need to register or represent a business or
organization to get the most competitive foam pricing on the net.

selection of acoustic foam sound treatment products at wholesale prices. Terrific for taming mid and
high-frequency reflections and echoes, acoustical wedge foam and acoustical eggcrate foam can
improve the clarity of your listening room or recording space without spending an arm and a leg. In
addition to the wedge and eggcrate foam tiles, we also offer wholesale bass and broadband treatment,
all available in rich, vibrant colors to help your room look as great as it will sound.

Memory foam sheets are another product offered at low, wholesale prices. Sold in standard mattress
sizes and various thicknesses, these can be used to build a custom mattress, used as a memory foam
topper, or turned into a memory foam cushion. Memory foam is temperature-sensitive and softens with
the heat from the user’s body. This creates custom contouring that greatly relieves pressure and
improves comfort in any application.

At Foam Factory, we specialize in [polyurethane foam sheets][48], packaging foam, and specialty foam
materials like rebond and Dryfast outdoor cushion foam. We have all the wholesale upholstery and
comfort materials you could need at great prices. So if it’s foam you need, and low prices you want,
FoamDistributing.com from Foam Factory is right for you!

to find a low-cost, hassle-free foam material supplier, or an individual on a quest for great prices
on premium foam materials, Foam Factory has just what you’ve been looking for.

With Foam Factory’s wholesale pricing, what you see is what you get. This is great for small
businesses and upholstery shops looking for a bulk supplier, because every penny counts and being
able to accurately budget keeps things running smoothly. The last thing any company wants is to
receive an invoice with extra pop-up fees because of services or charges that were only mentioned
after the fact. Without tiered pricing, you’ll never have to buy more than you need to get the best
deal on an item either, whether you’re ordering 1 or 100. Individual customers are welcome to take
advantage of our wholesale pricing as well. There’s no need to register or represent a business or
organization to get the most competitive foam pricing on the net.

selection of acoustic foam sound treatment products at wholesale prices. Terrific for taming mid and
high-frequency reflections and echoes, acoustical wedge foam and acoustical eggcrate foam can
improve the clarity of your listening room or recording space without spending an arm and a leg. In
addition to the wedge and eggcrate foam tiles, we also offer wholesale bass and broadband treatment,
all available in rich, vibrant colors to help your room look as great as it will sound.

sizes and various thicknesses, these can be used to build a custom mattress, used as a memory foam
topper, or turned into a memory foam cushion. Memory foam is temperature-sensitive and softens with
the heat from the user’s body. This creates custom contouring that greatly relieves pressure and
improves comfort in any application.

At Foam Factory, we specialize in [polyurethane foam sheets][48], packaging foam, and specialty foam
materials like rebond and Dryfast outdoor cushion foam. We have all the wholesale upholstery and
comfort materials you could need at great prices. So if it’s foam you need, and low prices you want,
FoamDistributing.com from Foam Factory is right for you!

## Frequently Asked Questions

With over four decades of providing our clients with industry leading foam packaging solutions, we
wanted to share some of the most common questions we recieve from both current and prospective
customers about foam packaging and how it is able to best protect their product.

#### What is Polyurethane Foam?

Polyurethane foam is a flexible and resilient open-cell foam that makes it feel softer than other
foams. Our sheets are dimensionally stable and will not twist, warp or bow. It will tolerate extreme
extreme cold or heat and retain excellent strength, stability and rigidity even at high heats. This
foam is highly resistant to most chemicals and solvents, won’t absorb water, rot, or decompose in
subgrade applications.

### What Is Polyurethane Foam Used For?

This foam is excellent for customization as it can be shaped to the exact dimensions of any product.
Both the density and the firmness can be changed based on the products requirements. This foam can
be cut or molded to a specific shape and is very durable as it will withstand extreme temperature
changes.

### How often must the cleanroom be tested for compliance with air standards?

We test our [cleanroom][44] to ensure that it continues to perform efficiently related to air
cleanliness standards every 6 months, even though the ISO 7 standard for testing and validation
ifrequency s every 12 months.

### ** Does the Cleanroom’s Layout Promote Efficiency and Reduce Biocontamination?**

When we designed and constructed our [ISO 7 Cleanroom][45] (class 10,000) we utilized a
well-conceived layout which enables air to move with uniform velocity and along parallel flow lines.
We carefully designed and placed our workstations and machines in relation to the walls to achieve
laminar flow. This reduces turbulence, which allows for the reduction of particle production and the
introduction of microrganisms.

### WHAT ARE ALL THE CLEANROOM SERVICES?

Our [cleanroom packaging services][46] cater to our clients in the semiconductor, aerospace and
medical industries. These services include design and engineering, die-cutting, laminating, sheeting
and assembly. We manufacture, fabricate and assemble foam inserts and packaging solutions with
technical compliance and exceed the standard air-flow rate for an ISO 7 filtration system of 9-16
CFM per square foot.

### WHY CHOOSE US?

Foam Packaging Specialties has been an industry leader in the foam packaging industry since 1976. We
use the highest quality foams in our protective packaging solutions and can quickly accomodate high
volume orders for short or long-run production at our state-of-the-art facility in Tempe, Arizona.
We take pride in providing our customers with the highest standards in design, production quality
and customer service!

This foam is excellent for customization as it can be shaped to the exact dimensions of any product.
Both the density and the firmness can be changed based on the products requirements. This foam can
be cut or molded to a specific shape and is very durable as it will withstand extreme temperature
changes.

### How often must the cleanroom be tested for compliance with air standards?

We test our [cleanroom][44] to ensure that it continues to perform efficiently related to air
cleanliness standards every 6 months, even though the ISO 7 standard for testing and validation
ifrequency s every 12 months.

### ** Does the Cleanroom’s Layout Promote Efficiency and Reduce Biocontamination?**

When we designed and constructed our [ISO 7 Cleanroom][45] (class 10,000) we utilized a
well-conceived layout which enables air to move with uniform velocity and along parallel flow lines.
We carefully designed and placed our workstations and machines in relation to the walls to achieve
laminar flow. This reduces turbulence, which allows for the reduction of particle production and the
introduction of microrganisms.

### WHAT ARE ALL THE CLEANROOM SERVICES?

Our [cleanroom packaging services][46] cater to our clients in the semiconductor, aerospace and
medical industries. These services include design and engineering, die-cutting, laminating, sheeting
and assembly. We manufacture, fabricate and assemble foam inserts and packaging solutions with
technical compliance and exceed the standard air-flow rate for an ISO 7 filtration system of 9-16
CFM per square foot.

### WHY CHOOSE US?

Foam Packaging Specialties has been an industry leader in the foam packaging industry since 1976. We
use the highest quality foams in our protective packaging solutions and can quickly accomodate high
volume orders for short or long-run production at our state-of-the-art facility in Tempe, Arizona.
We take pride in providing our customers with the highest standards in design, production quality
and customer service!

Form Plastics is an industry leader in the packaging industry, providing the most innovative food
packaging solutions. We believe in food packaging with a purpose—our eco-friendly packaging and
customizable containers and equipment are designed to meet our customers' unique needs and improve
their business and customer experience.

## Food Packaging Solutions

[Clear plastic meal container - Flip it Fresh container]

### Plastic and Paper Food Trays

We manufacture plastic and paper food trays in various styles and sizes to accommodate your food
service packaging needs. From grab-n-go containers to platters, specialty, and [custom plastic
trays][42], Form Plastics has food tray options for you.

[Learn More][43]
[Lidding film rolls]

### Lidding and Overwrap Film

We offer various film types, roll widths, lengths, gauges, and core sizes, including [lidding
film][44], specialty film, and [overwrap film][45]. Food service films such as lidding and overwrap
are converted and slit in-house.

[Learn More][46]
[HCM100 Heat Seal Lidding machine]

### Tray Sealing Machines & Equipment

We develop the industry's most advanced, safest, and innovative [tray sealing machines][47], [hinged
paperboard sealing equipment][48], and [auxiliary equipment][49]. Our state-of-the-art packaging
solutions include automatic, semi-automatic, and manual tray sealing machines and lidding equipment.

[Learn More][50]

## WHY CHOOSE **FORM PLASTICS**

We are a reliable and trusted source of innovative food service products and solutions for the food
service industry, such as stocked and custom plastic trays, food service films and tray sealing
machines. Form Plastics’ expertise, industry knowledge, and history of reliability help customers
streamline their production process, improve their customer experience, and more.

products.

Over 60 years of experience for all types of plastic and high-performance polymers, from commodity
to expanded and recycled, thermoplastic, techno-polymers and composites.

Our expertise extends to hybrid materials including expanded polypropylene (EPP) and other foam
materials. These materials offer a unique combination of properties to deliver energy absorption,
high structural strength, very low weight, chemical resistance, thermal and acoustic insulation
while being 100% recyclable.

### Integrated Foam

We serve global clients with cutting-edge foam technology for lightweight, cushioning and
insulation.

## Specialists in Precision Thermoforming

At Indepak, we specialize in designing and forming intricate, complex shapes with a high level of
detail while holding tight tolerances.  Our focus on continual innovation and dedication to quality
and service has earned us an exceptional reputation as one of the leading manufacturers of
thermoformed trays, clamshells and blister packaging. We are the precision thermoforming specialists
that will provide a solution for you.

#### Food Packaging

Our success in the food packaging market can be attributed to our commitment to quality and
innovation. From helping clients meet shelf life requirements to designing parts that de-nest
quickly and consistently, we can do it all.

##### Why Indepak?
* FSSC 22000 Certified
* Knowledge of lidding and barrier films
* Experience with automated parts feeding

[Read More][67]

#### Medical Packaging

With specially designed processes related to cleaning, PPE, signage and the use of medical grade
materials, Indepak has been a trusted supplier of precision packaging for medical, lab and
pharmaceutical companies for decades.


##### Why Indepak?
* Produce “low particulate parts”
* Operate traceability programs
* Offer silicone coated or internal de-nest material options

[Read More][68]

#### Electronics Packaging

We understand the sensitivity of packaging electronic parts and have worked with leading global
manufacturers to develop the procedures, processes and equipment to ensure success for even the most
challenging applications.


##### Why Indepak?
* Work with static dissipative and conductive materials
* Tight tolerance cavities for pick-and-place automation
* Experience with automated parts feeding

[Read More][69]

#### Retail Packaging

Our experienced design team can collaborate with you to design functional and aesthetically pleasing
packaging that will make your product stand out while also considering aspects such as security,
package fulfillment and sealing methods.


##### Why Indepak?
* In-house design and prototyping
* Material specifying and sustainability
* Experience collaborating with other packaging suppliers

[Read More][70]

#### Industrial Packaging

The increased adoption of automated pick-and-place robots along with the ongoing focus on continual
quality improvement and the need for more sustainable packaging has helped Indepak become a leader
in precision thermoformed trays and totes for industrial applications.


##### Why Indepak?
* Ability to design for automation
* Precision thermoforming of intricate shapes
* Innovative “rotate-to-stack” designs

[Read More][71]

#### Agricultural Packaging

Located in Portland, Oregon, a center of environmental innovation, Indepak has always exhibited a
great commitment to serving the agricultural market with high-quality, precision parts at
competitive prices.


##### Why Indepak?
* Commitment to the environment
* Precision molding capabilities
* Better performance through better design

[Read More][72]

customer-centric, service-first approach yields timely, accurate and cost-effective solutions from

#### SERVICES

Total Solutions

Indepak delivers innovation, flexibility and assurance as we supply a **Total Solution**. Our
customer-centric, service-first approach yields timely, accurate and cost-effective solutions from
initial design and development through ongoing supply chain management.

##### DESIGN

Indepak has worked closely with our customers to design thousands of innovative packages and
products over the years. We pay attention to space, weight, strength, presentation, cost
containment, etc. so that you end up with the best solution for each application. The precision of
our custom thermoforming team and the end products produced are of the highest level of quality.

**LEARN MORE**

##### PROTOTYPING & TOOLING

We offer a variety of in house options to ensure that the part design will perform to your
expectations. They range from parts formed on soft sample tooling to production quality sample molds
for applications where the design is more finalized and a production quality part is required.
Having a physical prototype part to check fits and test saves valuable time in the development
process.

**LEARN MORE**

##### PRECISION THERMOFORMING

Over the last 5 decades, the Indepak custom thermoforming team’s talent for mechanical engineering
has resulted in a number of pioneering breakthroughs as they developed over 6,000 different products
– many of which people “didn’t think could be done.” Today, as a division of Sinclair & Rush,
Indepak continues to lead in innovation, service and value.

**LEARN MORE**

##### INVENTORY MANAGEMENT

To offer the security of inventory and convenience of quicker shipping response times, Indepak can
partner with you to optimize and manage inventory. We commonly maintain agreed upon inventory levels
both at Indepak and also at our customers’ facilities.

Interpak are designers and manufacturers of High Performance [Stratocell foam packs][44] and also
composite packs. [Polyethylene Foam][45] is the ideal packaging product for heavier items as it is
extremely resilient and will protect your product from knocks and scrapes in transit.

[Polyurethane foam][46] is another option for cushion packaging - softer than stratocell it provides
all round protection for lighter weight products. Also used for [Display case inserts.][47]

Exporting your products ? We recommend [ISPM15 Crates][48]  for international transit worldwide.
Crates can be built to any size - and we can add internal Foam lining where required - or indeed
bespoke foam inserts for extra cushioning.

[Flight Cases ][49] provide the ultimate safe reusable pack - built to your specification.

We can work from sketches , samples or any electronic form of drawings to design your packs. We also
carry a range of General Packaging Materials such as [Bubblewrap][50], [cartons][51], [tapes
][52]etc. for general packaging requirements. With over 40 years experience in our field - we will
be well equipped to deal with your enquiry and create the perfect pack for your requirements.

## "Aesthetically pleasing" Protective Packaging.

### Lightweight : Versatile : Recyclable

#### FOAM PACKS

Interpak are specialists in the Design and fabrication of packs utilising many types of foam. We
have full Cutting and Fabrication facilities In - House. We carry block foam in stock as well as all
thicknesses of Stratocell sheet. Also as the manufacturer we offer swift turnaround.
 

[ Read more ...][53]

####  FABRICATION

We can press and laminate all types of foam inserts and case inserts for any items. We offer many
grades of foam in a range of colours to achieve the finish you need. We also stock CMHR foam for
furniture - so if your cushions needs replacing - give us a call.We offer  "On the spot "hand cut
samples. 
 

[ Read more ...][54]

#### FLIGHT CASES

Flight Cases built to any size and specification. These can have built in ramps,wheels, pull
handles, locking catches , removable panels and many other attributes . Whatever you need from a
flight case - we can build it for you . We will be happy to discuss your requirements 
    

[ Read more ...][55]

#### ISPM15 CRATES

Plywood Crates built to any size and specification. These are fully ISPM15 compliant which means you
can ship them anywhere in the world. Crates can be supplied with or without foam lining - and with
removable panels to facilitate easy loading if required .

Ask us for more information. 

[ Read more ...][56]

Interpak are designers and manufacturers of High Performance [Stratocell foam packs][44] and also
composite packs. [Polyethylene Foam][45] is the ideal packaging product for heavier items as it is
extremely resilient and will protect your product from knocks and scrapes in transit.

[Polyurethane foam][46] is another option for cushion packaging - softer than stratocell it provides
all round protection for lighter weight products. Also used for [Display case inserts.][47]

Exporting your products ? We recommend [ISPM15 Crates][48]  for international transit worldwide.
Crates can be built to any size - and we can add internal Foam lining where required - or indeed
bespoke foam inserts for extra cushioning.

[Flight Cases ][49] provide the ultimate safe reusable pack - built to your specification.

We can work from sketches , samples or any electronic form of drawings to design your packs. We also
carry a range of General Packaging Materials such as [Bubblewrap][50], [cartons][51], [tapes
][52]etc. for general packaging requirements. With over 40 years experience in our field - we will
be well equipped to deal with your enquiry and create the perfect pack for your requirements.

## "Aesthetically pleasing" Protective Packaging.

### Lightweight : Versatile : Recyclable

#### FOAM PACKS

Interpak are specialists in the Design and fabrication of packs utilising many types of foam. We
have full Cutting and Fabrication facilities In - House. We carry block foam in stock as well as all
thicknesses of Stratocell sheet. Also as the manufacturer we offer swift turnaround.
 

[ Read more ...][53]

####  FABRICATION

We can press and laminate all types of foam inserts and case inserts for any items. We offer many
grades of foam in a range of colours to achieve the finish you need. We also stock CMHR foam for
furniture - so if your cushions needs replacing - give us a call.We offer  "On the spot "hand cut
samples. 
 

[ Read more ...][54]

#### FLIGHT CASES

Flight Cases built to any size and specification. These can have built in ramps,wheels, pull
handles, locking catches , removable panels and many other attributes . Whatever you need from a
flight case - we can build it for you . We will be happy to discuss your requirements 
    

[ Read more ...][55]

#### ISPM15 CRATES

Plywood Crates built to any size and specification. These are fully ISPM15 compliant which means you
can ship them anywhere in the world. Crates can be supplied with or without foam lining - and with
removable panels to facilitate easy loading if required .

Ask us for more information.

# Foam engineered for life

[ [partially recycled foam blocks, introducing more sustainable products] View by**Material** ][57]

## **Bespoke foam solutions, engineered for precision**

Welcome to Kewell Converters, where bespoke foam conversion and foam fabrication are at the heart of
everything we do. With over 50 years of exclusive experience working with foam materials, we’re the
UK’s most experienced independent foam converter—trusted by procurement teams and engineers in the
[aerospace][58], military, [defence][59], and [industrial][60] sectors.

We don’t just manufacture components—we solve problems. Our expert engineering [team][61], paired
with our full CAD design service, develops specialised foam solutions that meet exact performance,
durability, and environmental requirements. Whether you’re looking for custom foam inserts,
protective foam packaging, or engineered foam parts, we deliver with precision, speed and technical
confidence.

[Find out more][62]

## **Uncompromising on **[**quality**][63]

**Certified to ISO 9001:2015 – because quality can’t be optional**

At Kewell Converters, quality is built into every layer of our process. We operate to [ISO
9001:2015][64] standards, ensuring consistently high-quality foam parts and bespoke foam solutions
that meet even the strictest tolerances.

This matters most in high-risk sectors like [defence][65] and [aerospace][66], where performance
must be proven and reliability is non-negotiable. With a team of 30 skilled professionals and an
advanced production facility, we guarantee attention to detail, accountability, and dependable
delivery across every project.

[Quality at Kewell Converters][67]

> We have relied on Kewell Converters to accurately translate quite complex drawings for more than a
> decade. We would recommend them for difficult work.

Director, UK Defense Industry

# Foam engineered for life

[ [Plastazote foam application for the military and defence industry] View by**Industry** ][56]
[ [partially recycled foam blocks, introducing more sustainable products] View by**Material** ][57]

## **Bespoke foam solutions, engineered for precision**

Welcome to Kewell Converters, where bespoke foam conversion and foam fabrication are at the heart of
everything we do. With over 50 years of exclusive experience working with foam materials, we’re the
UK’s most experienced independent foam converter—trusted by procurement teams and engineers in the
[aerospace][58], military, [defence][59], and [industrial][60] sectors.

We don’t just manufacture components—we solve problems. Our expert engineering [team][61], paired
with our full CAD design service, develops specialised foam solutions that meet exact performance,
durability, and environmental requirements. Whether you’re looking for custom foam inserts,
protective foam packaging, or engineered foam parts, we deliver with precision, speed and technical
confidence.

[Find out more][62]

## **Uncompromising on **[**quality**][63]

**Certified to ISO 9001:2015 – because quality can’t be optional**

At Kewell Converters, quality is built into every layer of our process. We operate to [ISO
9001:2015][64] standards, ensuring consistently high-quality foam parts and bespoke foam solutions
that meet even the strictest tolerances.

This matters most in high-risk sectors like [defence][65] and [aerospace][66], where performance
must be proven and reliability is non-negotiable. With a team of 30 skilled professionals and an
advanced production facility, we guarantee attention to detail, accountability, and dependable
delivery across every project.

[Quality at Kewell Converters][67]

> We have relied on Kewell Converters to accurately translate quite complex drawings for more than a
> decade. We would recommend them for difficult work.

Director, UK Defense Industry

> Quick turnaround of samples and advice on feasibility issues, quality of products supplied usually
> to the standard expected or above, and expectations met in terms of lead times.

Product Manager, UK Innovation

> Flexible with improving designs and working with sometimes inadequate files, quote turnaround time
> usually same day and good communication.

Managing Director, UK Promotional
[CNC routing machine, cutting case inserts]

## **Engineered for high performance**

**Foam that performs under pressure**

We understand the demands of extreme environments. That’s why our custom foam components are
designed to withstand impact, vibration, temperature extremes, and environmental challenges.

Using advanced foam fabrication techniques and the latest CNC machinery, we manufacture complex foam
parts to precise tolerances – whether it’s a lightweight foam panel, foam gasket, strip, or
protective insert. Our expertise in specialty foams, including Zotefoams and other [branded
foams][68], enables us to match the right material to your performance needs.

[Kewell-Converters-Sustainable-Practice-ISO-14001-Recycle]

## **Sustainable foam manufacturing**

**Smart solutions. Smaller footprint.**

[Sustainability][69] matters — and at Kewell Converters, we act on it. Our processes are certified
to [ISO 14001][70], reflecting our commitment to sustainable foam conversion and responsible
manufacturing.

We continuously optimise our production workflows to minimise waste, maximise material usage, and
reduce energy consumption — without compromising quality. Our goal is to provide manufactured foam
solutions that support your ESG goals without compromising performance.

## **Innovation that solves problems**

Investing in better outcomes for our customers

Innovation is more than a buzzword for us — it’s how we bring ideas to life. From integrating
advanced [CAD][71] and [CNC][72] systems to exploring the latest foam fabrication techniques, we’re
constantly evolving to serve the changing needs of our customers.

Our design-led approach means we collaborate early in the process, offering design for manufacturing
guidance and prototyping to get your solution right first time.

Discover how our innovative thinking has helped customers in your sector on our [case studies][73]
page.

[Our skilled engineers deep in discussion in the factory]

## **Built on trust and integrity**

**A family-run business with a national reputation**

For over five decades, customers have trusted Kewell Converters for honest advice, technical
clarity, and consistent quality. As a family-run company, we’re proud to build long-term
partnerships, not just fulfill orders.

We’re not just here to convert foam — we’re here to make your job easier, your supply chain simpler,
and your product better. Don’t just take our word for it — visit our [Testimonials][74] to see what
our customers have to say.

## Ready to start your foam project?

Let’s talk. Whether you’re looking for bespoke foam parts, a long-term partner for foam fabrication,
or a team that can manage the whole supply chain for you, Kewell Converters is ready to help.

[Contact us][75] today or send an enquiry – and find out how we can add value to your next project.

# WELCOME TO KAMAKSHA THERMOCOL


KAMAKSHA THERMOCOL is well established firm dealing with packaging products since 1999. Today,
KAMAKSHA THERMOCOL is a multi-location company with manufacturing facilities located in Western
India. We are Manufacturer, Supplier of Expanded Polystyrene (i.e. EPS or Thermocol)EPS Blocks /
Thermocol Blocks, EPS Cut Sheets, EPS Boxes / Thermocol Boxes , Thermocol Beads / Beans, Special
Customized Packaging Materials, Thermocol Chips, Corrugated Boxes, Polypropylene Boxes (PP Boxes) ,
Air Bubble Films & Bags, Polyrethane Foam (PU Foam), Bopp Tapes, Stretch Films, bopp Tapes, EPE Foam
Packaging, Corner Foam Guards, EPE Foam Buffers, EPE Foam Bags, EPE Foam Boxes, EPE Foam Inserts,

Quality Assurance

## Seven checkpoints between your brief and your dock.

A predictable quality pipeline — every stage owned by a named engineer, every stage documented.
1. 01
   
   ### Customer Requirement
   
   Drawing, sample or product photo captured with weight, drop-height and environment brief.
2. 02
   
   ### CAD Design
   
   3D fitment CAD generated and shared for approval before any cut.
3. 03
   
   ### Prototype
   
   Physical prototype produced on the actual machine that will run production.
4. 04
   
   ### Production
   
   Batch cut with signed BOM, calibrated tooling and lot traceability.
5. 05
   
   ### Quality Inspection
   
   Dimensional QC, fit-check against master part, foam-density verification.
6. 06
   
   ### Packing
   
   Poly-bagged, labeled with SKU + lot, packed in export-safe cartons.
7. 07
   
   ### Dispatch
   
   Consignment shipped pan-India with tracking and delivery confirmation.

   ### Prototype

   ### Packing

recognized for their exceptional performance.

### NPX ONE’s 50+ year heritage features several industry leaders, including W.R. Grace, Formpac,
### Sealed Air and Cryovac.

NPX ONE is partnered with Breck Partners, LLC (“Breck”), a Dallas-based private equity firm.

### Functionality, Value and Convenience

Since 1965, fresh food processors and retailers have relied on our polystyrene food trays to improve
the integrity, appearance, safety and economics of packaged proteins.

[ Learn More ][31]

Available in a range of colors, sizes and strengths, our polystyrenefoam supermarket trays improve
the appearance, merchandising andconsumer takeaway of fresh meat, poultry and seafood.

Designed, manufactured and serviced by NPX ONE’s team of packagingtechnologists, our processor trays

[ Learn More ][33]

#### NPX ONE Barrier

When combined with the appropriate lid stock, the NPX ONE Barrier tray creates a modified atmosphere
packaging system that extends shelf life and increases packing efficiencies.

[ Learn More ][34]

# BUILT FOR ADVENTURE


[Get a quote][8] or [View our FAQ][9]

On Track Fabrication (OTF), based in Perth, Western Australia, is a premier provider of
high-quality, custom-built steel and aluminum trays, canopies, 4x4 accessories, and vehicle body
solutions. As experts in vehicle body building, OTF specialises in chassis extensions, chassis
repairs, ROPS (Roll Over Protection System) certified trays, and dual cab conversions to enhance
both the functionality and safety of your vehicle. With a strong commitment to precision
engineering, safety, and customer satisfaction, OTF ensures that every product meets the highest
industry standards while exceeding customer expectations. Whether you need a custom tray, canopy,
complete body modification, or a dual cab conversion, OTF is your trusted partner for top-tier 4x4
and vehicle building solutions.

## Our Products

[CHASSIS HEADER]

##### Chassis Works

When it comes to chassis extensions, bracing, and repairs, On Track Fabrication is the name
professionals trust in Perth, Western Australia, and throughout Australia. As leading vehicle body
builders, we’re the only place to go for precision work, exceptional craftsmanship, and results that
stand the test of time.

[Find out more][10]
[ee95143d-fc0b-4ebf-93fe-dac125945dd5]

##### Canopies & Tool Boxes

Experience unmatched off-road durability with our canopies and toolboxes, expertly crafted for
rugged exploration and built to withstand the toughest conditions. Engineered for both adventure and
work, each unit combines strength, functionality, and lasting reliability, ensuring your vehicle is
ready for anything.

[Find out more][11]
[7e766a40-a1d6-4b6f-8f27-0fb9a42418d4]

##### Steel & Alloy Trays

Upgrade with OTF Heavy-Duty Ute & Truck Trays Boost your vehicle’s performance with OTF’s tough
aluminum and steel ute and truck trays. Engineered for strength, versatility, and style, they’re
perfect for work, trade, or adventure. Built to withstand the harshest conditions and perform on any
terrain, OTF trays combine durability, functionality, and precision craftsmanship to keep your
vehicle ready for anything.

[Find out more][12]

## What People Say

We used On Track Fabrication for our custom canopy on our 4WD. Having heard some good things, we
discussed with the team what we wanted in our touring setup and for sure, the end result did not
disappoint.

The canopy has a high quality finish and is a blend of style and functionality; a testament to their
commitment to quality and design.

On Track Fabrication’s amazing welding skills will ensure a years of durable service for our setup.
Their dedication to producing fully customised and bespoke solutions is very evident.
Their team was attentive, understanding, and always ready to accommodate our specific requirements.
They truly cared for quality and it’s clear in the results they deliver.
If you’re in the market for a stylish and unique canopy, On Track Fabrication should be your first
choice. With their meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to customer
satisfaction, they offer a level of craftsmanship that’s truly remarkable.

Aaron & Veronica Newman

The team at OTF carried out a 300mm wheelbase extension and built and fitted a heavy duty alloy tray
and canopy to our LC79 Series.  The quality of workmanship is exceptional and it’s proven itself all
through the Kimberley, Pilbara and those bloody corrugations to Ningaloo!  Luke and Nerissa and the
crew at OTF always went the extra mile and were an absolute pleasure to deal with.  It’s great to be
looked after by honest people who know what they’re doing and take pride in their build.”  Thanks
again guys

Andrew Sarich

Nerissa and Luke were a pleasure to deal with – not only providing a prompt and professional
service, but also very friendly and accommodating. The finished product is fantastic, and exactly
what we asked for. The workmanship and attention to detail is second to none. We would not hesitate
to recommend these guys to anyone.

Ben & Kathy Taylor

committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.

## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

> Manpower and skilled professionals are two of the biggest exports of the Philippines to the world.
> With a promise of better employment conditions and desirable career paths, overseas jobs have
> become appealing to many Filipino professionals. That is why the number of professionals and
> skilled workers is growing relentlessly year-on-year.

### OFW’s Preparation Guide before going Abroad

Leaving home to work abroad is not a simple and straightforward process. Aside from the usual
recruitment procedures that an OFW hopeful must go through, there are plenty of preparations that
must be done.
1. **Attend PEOS** – The Pre-Employment Orientation Seminar (PEOS) is conducted by the POEA in the
   main office or at the POEA regional offices.
2. **Submission of Application and Requirements** – Submit application form and all the requirements
   being asked from you. The basic required documents are: personal data sheets, transcript of
   records, high school and college diplomas, certificate(s) of employment, board certificate(s),
   training and trade certificates (if applicable), passport, and 2″x2″ pictures.
3. **Undergo Preliminary Interview and Evaluation** – You may have to attend a pre-application
   orientation being conducted by the concerned recruiter/local agent so you can be informed of the
   details of the employment offer. If you meet the minimum qualifications of the job, you will be
   asked to undergo testing and/or interviews among other screening procedures.
4. **Undergo Medical and Trade Testing** – If selected, you will be instructed to proceed to an
   accredited medical clinic for basic medical examination and to any TESDA-accredited testing
   centers, if necessary, to ensure that you are fit to work.
5. **Discussion of the Terms and Conditions of Employment and Signing of Contract** – When you pass
   the medical exam and trade testing, you will be asked to sign an employment contract. REMEMBER,
   before signing a contract, read and study first all the provisions. Do not sign the contract, nor
   pay any fee unless you have fully understood and agreed to the indicated terms and conditions.
   Always demand for a receipt once a payment is made.
6. **Processing of your documents with the POEA and concerned embassies or entities** – Your agency
   will now proceed to process your documents with the following entities:
   1. Concerned Foreign Embassy – Visa issuance/stamping
   2. Philippine Overseas Employment Administration (POEA) – for registration and documentation of
      employment contracts as well as issuance of e-Receipt or Overseas Employment Certificates
      (OEC)
   3. Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) – if certain documents need translation and authentication
      (e.g. employment contract written wholly in the foreign language)
   4. Concerned AIRLINE – for issuance of booking certificates

> Manpower and skilled professionals are two of the biggest exports of the Philippines to the world.
> With a promise of better employment conditions and desirable career paths, overseas jobs have
> become appealing to many Filipino professionals. That is why the number of professionals and
> skilled workers is growing relentlessly year-on-year.

### OFW’s Preparation Guide before going Abroad

Leaving home to work abroad is not a simple and straightforward process. Aside from the usual
recruitment procedures that an OFW hopeful must go through, there are plenty of preparations that
must be done.
1. **Attend PEOS** – The Pre-Employment Orientation Seminar (PEOS) is conducted by the POEA in the
   main office or at the POEA regional offices.
2. **Submission of Application and Requirements** – Submit application form and all the requirements
   being asked from you. The basic required documents are: personal data sheets, transcript of
   records, high school and college diplomas, certificate(s) of employment, board certificate(s),
   training and trade certificates (if applicable), passport, and 2″x2″ pictures.
3. **Undergo Preliminary Interview and Evaluation** – You may have to attend a pre-application
   orientation being conducted by the concerned recruiter/local agent so you can be informed of the
   details of the employment offer. If you meet the minimum qualifications of the job, you will be
   asked to undergo testing and/or interviews among other screening procedures.
4. **Undergo Medical and Trade Testing** – If selected, you will be instructed to proceed to an
   accredited medical clinic for basic medical examination and to any TESDA-accredited testing
   centers, if necessary, to ensure that you are fit to work.
5. **Discussion of the Terms and Conditions of Employment and Signing of Contract** – When you pass
   the medical exam and trade testing, you will be asked to sign an employment contract. REMEMBER,
   before signing a contract, read and study first all the provisions. Do not sign the contract, nor
   pay any fee unless you have fully understood and agreed to the indicated terms and conditions.
   Always demand for a receipt once a payment is made.
6. **Processing of your documents with the POEA and concerned embassies or entities** – Your agency
   will now proceed to process your documents with the following entities:
   1. Concerned Foreign Embassy – Visa issuance/stamping
   2. Philippine Overseas Employment Administration (POEA) – for registration and documentation of
      employment contracts as well as issuance of e-Receipt or Overseas Employment Certificates
      (OEC)
   3. Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) – if certain documents need translation and authentication
      (e.g. employment contract written wholly in the foreign language)
   4. Concerned AIRLINE – for issuance of booking certificates

## Leading Manufacturer of Dental & Industrial Safety Disposable Products

Founded in 1990, Sanax Protective Products has strived to manufacture the best possible infection
control and disposable products to our valued customers worldwide. Our products are sold in the
medical, dental, veterinary and tattoo markets. We have partnered with various manufacturers in
China, Thailand and worldwide to produce products that meet or exceed governmental requirements in
the U.S., Europe, Australia, Japan and elsewhere.

Together with our dental product manufacturer partners, we work closely with NIOSH (National
Institute for Occupational Safety and Health) and the FDA (Food and Drug Administration) to insure
all our products are up-to-date from a regulatory standpoint. All our factories are ISO certified.
