### **Your comprehensive PACKAGING partner.**

SES Packaging Systems is an integrated manufacturer and marketer of returnable and expendable
packaging.
At SES Packaging Systems, quality is our mission. No matter your packaging requirements, we are
committed to delivering exactly what you need, when you need it. 

### **COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE**

We're committed to maintaining our core focus on excellence with every product we create. We strive
to create products that are precisely tailored to your specifications.

### **CUSTOM DESIGN**

Our team of foam fabrication experts will work with you to develop or adapt your design, ensuring it
is shaped and made ideally for its protective purpose.

[Industrial machine with orange components processing a sheet of material, possibly in a
manufacturing setting.]

#### Steel Rule Die Cutting
* VIEW MORE
  
  An automated process where rolled or sheeted material is cut to a predetermined shape and size
  with mounted cutting tools, commonly referred to as a 'clicker cut' or 'punch cut'.

[Industrial foam cutting machine in action]

#### SKIVING
* VIEW MORE
  
  Roller skiving cuts materials to your desired thickness. Roller Splitting/Skiving operates by
  compressing the material between two rollers to push it through a fixed, ultra sharp knife edged
  blade. Thickness is controlled by the relative distance of the rollers from the blade and the
  amount of compression required to push the foam through the blade. Roller splitting/skiving can
  process large quantities of material faster and handle higher-density materials.

[Close-up of a hand holding a pen, drawing on architectural blueprints on a table.]

#### ENGINEERING SERVICES
* VIEW MORE
  
  In the automotive industry, SES Packaging leads the design and implementation of expendable and
  reusable packaging systems that drive supply chain optimization. With over 25 years of industry
  experience, SES Packaging experts design and implement effective packaging to meet your
  requirements. SES Engineering Services experts are available on-site or off-site to seamlessly
  implement cost-effective packaging programs. Implementation Services projects can range from one
  day to a week or more, depending on the application.

[Waterjet cutting machine working on a piece of material]

#### WATERJET CUTTING
* VIEW MORE
  
  An automated process of cutting into material using a jet of water or a mixture of water with
  abrasive material, at high velocity and pressure.

[Industrial machine with metal roller compressing layers of blue and white foam.]

#### HEAT LAMINATION
* VIEW MORE
  
  Heat lamination is the process of bringing two surfaces together by heat to form a thicker block
  with a laminated bond equivalent in strength to that of the individual sheets. Heat lamination
  combines different materials, densities, and colors to create multi-layer composite sheets.
  
  SES currently offers heat lamination service in Scarborough, Ontario. By pushing the materials
  through a heated blade, the heat melts the surface of the foam, turning it into a tacky substance
  that essentially acts as an adhesive and creates a permanent bond. It is more cost effective and
  better performance when compared to glue or adhesive. We can combine different materials,
  densities, and colors to create multi-layer composite sheets.

[Industrial textile cutting machine with green conveyor belt and white fabric]

#### ADDITIONAL SUPPORT
* VIEW MORE
  
  Additional Support Capabilities
  
  SES Packaging Systems also provides additional support capabilities and services for primary and
  secondary packaging fabrication. They include the following:
  
  - Sonic Welding: Ultrasonic welding uses high-frequency vibration to melt and weld plastic. A tool
  vibrates at ultrasonic frequencies and causes concentrated molecular vibration in the weld joint.
  The friction between the molecules heats and melts the plastic.
  
  - Glue Application: Application of industrial strength adhesive through glue roll coater machines
  and high flow piston pump handgun systems.
  
  - Custom manufacturing of high-grade covers, tarps, and pouches for all industries ranging from
  Architectural to Transportation.
  
  - CNC Router Table: CNC router is a computer-controlled cutting machine which is used for cutting
  various materials such as composites, plastic

OUR PRODUCTS
* ## FOAM DUNNAGE
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][18]
* ## FOAM TRAYS
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][19]
* ## Paper Corrugated Kits
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][20]
* ## PLASTIC CORRUGATED PACKAGING
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][21]
* ## PLASTIC CORRUGATED TOTES
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][22]
* ## TOTES AND HANDHELD CONTAINERS
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][23]

#### INDUSTRIES WE SERVE
* #### AUTOMOTIVE
  
  Today’s vehicles are complex machines. Automobiles and trucks are also safer and easier to use
  because of newly engineered materials, component designs and assembly process improvements. Those
  innovations and technology enhancements improve performance and lower costs. This also holds true
  for the packaging products and material handling systems which SES Packaging designs and builds to
  serve automakers worldwide.
  
  We plan for tomorrow by crafting adjustable and environmentally friendly packaging that delivers
  years of reliable service to protect performance and quality.
* #### CONSTRUCTION
  
  Depending on the application the type of foam used for construction purposes can vary based on
  many factors. The most common factor is environmental exposure and exposure to UV rays. SES foam
  products can and are used in insulation, water sealing and noise sealing.
* #### GENERAL MANUFACTURING
  
  Our customers are diverse and specialized, manufacturing products for various markets. Their
  products range from specialty apparel and safety equipment to specialized machinery and consumer
  goods. SES offers a wide range of foam solutions for these manufacturers. Whether you need to
  waterjet cut, die cut, mold, glue, laminate, or fasten foam, we can provide a diverse range of
  manufactured components. 

# RESOURCES
* #### WHAT TYPE OF FOAM DO WE USE?
  
  What type of material do we use? 6 major materials.
  
  XLPE Foam - Cross-linked polyethylene foam (also known as XLPE) is a closed-cell foam
  characterized by a micro-cellular appearance and resistance to water. XLPE materials are used in
  applications that require protection of class “A” surfaces. XLPE foam is used extensively in
  packaging, moulded and die cut gaskets and seals. For die cut foam inserts and packaging, contact
  us today.
  
  PE Foam - Polyethylene foam is strong and resilient closed‐cell foam, ideally suited to absorbing
  shock in protective and cushion packaging applications.
  
  PU Foam - a flexible material, polyurethane foam is produced from combining polyol, isocyanate,
  and water. Polyurethane custom foam padding is highly durable and is used as cushioning in a wide
  array of products, such as packaging, furniture, car seats, and mattresses.
  
  Bubble Guard Board - Bubble GUARD is a multi-layer alveolar board made from 100% polypropylene
  with a unique circular honeycomb structure core at the centre and two flat surfaces on either side
  with great versatility and high performances. It is 100% eco-friendly & recyclable. Also available
  is the DOUBLE LAYER BUBBLEGUARD board with the highest weight range up to 6000 GSM.
  
  Fluted Polypropylene Coroplast - rigid material made of polypropylene plastic. Sheets of Coroplast
  have a fluted core and are smooth on both faces and are available with different material
  laminations on one or both sides.
  
  Kraft Paper - Kraft paper is produced through the chemical conversion of wood pulp, resulting in a
  strong and durable paper product.
* #### Is there a minimum Spend?
  
  No. Our orders range from $25.00 to $250 000.00 +
* #### What type of equipment do we use?
  
  The latest up to date equipment required for fabrication of packaging products.
* #### How long does manufacturing take?
  
  Depending on the packaging that is manufactured. Generally, all expendable packing is manufactured
  and shipped in 24 to 48 hours. Returnable packing, depending on the order size, material
  availability and complexity can range from a couple of days to 3 or 4 weeks.

At SES Packaging Systems, quality is our mission. No matter your packaging requirements, we are
committed to delivering exactly what you need, when you need it. 

### **COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE**

We're committed to maintaining our core focus on excellence with every product we create. We strive
to create products that are precisely tailored to your specifications.

### **CUSTOM DESIGN**

Our team of foam fabrication experts will work with you to develop or adapt your design, ensuring it
is shaped and made ideally for its protective purpose.

[Industrial machine with orange components processing a sheet of material, possibly in a
manufacturing setting.]

#### Steel Rule Die Cutting
* VIEW MORE
  
  An automated process where rolled or sheeted material is cut to a predetermined shape and size
  with mounted cutting tools, commonly referred to as a 'clicker cut' or 'punch cut'.

[Industrial foam cutting machine in action]

#### SKIVING
* VIEW MORE
  
  Roller skiving cuts materials to your desired thickness. Roller Splitting/Skiving operates by
  compressing the material between two rollers to push it through a fixed, ultra sharp knife edged
  blade. Thickness is controlled by the relative distance of the rollers from the blade and the
  amount of compression required to push the foam through the blade. Roller splitting/skiving can
  process large quantities of material faster and handle higher-density materials.

[Close-up of a hand holding a pen, drawing on architectural blueprints on a table.]

#### ENGINEERING SERVICES
* VIEW MORE
  
  In the automotive industry, SES Packaging leads the design and implementation of expendable and
  reusable packaging systems that drive supply chain optimization. With over 25 years of industry
  experience, SES Packaging experts design and implement effective packaging to meet your
  requirements. SES Engineering Services experts are available on-site or off-site to seamlessly
  implement cost-effective packaging programs. Implementation Services projects can range from one
  day to a week or more, depending on the application.

[Waterjet cutting machine working on a piece of material]

#### WATERJET CUTTING
* VIEW MORE
  
  An automated process of cutting into material using a jet of water or a mixture of water with
  abrasive material, at high velocity and pressure.

[Industrial machine with metal roller compressing layers of blue and white foam.]

#### HEAT LAMINATION
* VIEW MORE
  
  Heat lamination is the process of bringing two surfaces together by heat to form a thicker block
  with a laminated bond equivalent in strength to that of the individual sheets. Heat lamination
  combines different materials, densities, and colors to create multi-layer composite sheets.
  
  SES currently offers heat lamination service in Scarborough, Ontario. By pushing the materials
  through a heated blade, the heat melts the surface of the foam, turning it into a tacky substance
  that essentially acts as an adhesive and creates a permanent bond. It is more cost effective and
  better performance when compared to glue or adhesive. We can combine different materials,
  densities, and colors to create multi-layer composite sheets.

[Industrial textile cutting machine with green conveyor belt and white fabric]

#### ADDITIONAL SUPPORT
* VIEW MORE
  
  Additional Support Capabilities
  
  SES Packaging Systems also provides additional support capabilities and services for primary and
  secondary packaging fabrication. They include the following:
  
  - Sonic Welding: Ultrasonic welding uses high-frequency vibration to melt and weld plastic. A tool
  vibrates at ultrasonic frequencies and causes concentrated molecular vibration in the weld joint.
  The friction between the molecules heats and melts the plastic.
  
  - Glue Application: Application of industrial strength adhesive through glue roll coater machines
  and high flow piston pump handgun systems.
  
  - Custom manufacturing of high-grade covers, tarps, and pouches for all industries ranging from
  Architectural to Transportation.
  
  - CNC Router Table: CNC router is a computer-controlled cutting machine which is used for cutting
  various materials such as composites, plastics, and foams.

OUR PRODUCTS
* ## FOAM DUNNAGE
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][18]
* ## FOAM TRAYS
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][19]
* ## Paper Corrugated Kits
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][20]

  [ LEARN MORE ][21]
* ## PLASTIC CORRUGATED TOTES
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][22]
* ## TOTES AND HANDHELD CONTAINERS
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][23]

#### INDUSTRIES WE SERVE
* #### AUTOMOTIVE
  
  Today’s vehicles are complex machines. Automobiles and trucks are also safer and easier to use
  because of newly engineered materials, component designs and assembly process improvements. Those
  innovations and technology enhancements improve performance and lower costs. This also holds true
  for the packaging products and material handling systems which SES Packaging designs and builds to
  serve automakers worldwide.
  
  We plan for tomorrow by crafting adjustable and environmentally friendly packaging that delivers
  years of reliable service to protect performance and quality.
* #### CONSTRUCTION
  
  Depending on the application the type of foam used for construction purposes can vary based on
  many factors. The most common factor is environmental exposure and exposure to UV rays. SES foam
  products can and are used in insulation, water sealing and noise sealing.
* #### GENERAL MANUFACTURING
  
  Our customers are diverse and specialized, manufacturing products for various markets. Their
  products range from specialty apparel and safety equipment to specialized machinery and consumer
  goods. SES offers a wide range of foam solutions for these manufacturers. Whether you need to
  waterjet cut, die cut, mold, glue, laminate, or fasten foam, we can provide a diverse range of
  manufactured components. 

# RESOURCES
* #### WHAT TYPE OF FOAM DO WE USE?
  
  What type of material do we use? 6 major materials.
  
  XLPE Foam - Cross-linked polyethylene foam (also known as XLPE) is a closed-cell foam
  characterized by a micro-cellular appearance and resistance to water. XLPE materials are used in
  applications that require protection of class “A” surfaces. XLPE foam is used extensively in
  packaging, moulded and die cut gaskets and seals. For die cut foam inserts and packaging, contact
  us today.
  
  PE Foam - Polyethylene foam is strong and resilient closed‐cell foam, ideally suited to absorbing
  shock in protective and cushion packaging applications.
  
  PU Foam - a flexible material, polyurethane foam is produced from combining polyol, isocyanate,
  and water. Polyurethane custom foam padding is highly durable and is used as cushioning in a wide
  array of products, such as packaging, furniture, car seats, and mattresses.
  
  Bubble Guard Board - Bubble GUARD is a multi-layer alveolar board made from 100% polypropylene
  with a unique circular honeycomb structure core at the centre and two flat surfaces on either side
  with great versatility and high performances. It is 100% eco-friendly & recyclable. Also available
  is the DOUBLE LAYER BUBBLEGUARD board with the highest weight range up to 6000 GSM.
  
  Fluted Polypropylene Coroplast - rigid material made of polypropylene plastic. Sheets of Coroplast
  have a fluted core and are smooth on both faces and are available with different material
  laminations on one or both sides.
  
  Kraft Paper - Kraft paper is produced through the chemical conversion of wood pulp, resulting in a
  strong and durable paper product.
* #### Is there a minimum Spend?
  
  No. Our orders range from $25.00 to $250 000.00 +
* #### What type of equipment do we use?
  
  The latest up to date equipment required for fabrication of packaging products.
* #### How long does manufacturing take?
  
  Depending on the packaging that is manufactured. Generally, all expendable packing is manufactured
  and shipped in 24 to 48 hours. Returnable packing, depending on the order size, material
  availability and complexity can range from a couple of days to 3 or 4 weeks.

# Welcome to The Packaging Warehouse

## Manufacturers and Distributors of Plastic and Packaging Materials

Algoa Plastics have moved into their new premises in 6th Avenue, Newton Park, where they have opened
their new wholesale packaging section - "THE PACKAGING WAREHOUSE" supplying direct to the public at
wholesale prices.

"THE PACKAGING WAREHOUSE" stocks a comprehensive range of packaging to meet all your packaging
requirements. We have grown our product range to include a vast range of new packaging products and
have thereby established a truly one-stop-packaging-shop.

Please feel free to visit us at "THE PACKAGING WAREHOUSE" where you can browse through our store or
you can contact us to arrange for one of our representatives to visit you to discuss your packaging
requirements.

# Wanish: Keep Every Meal Perfectly Warm.

Elevate your hosting with Wanish Electric Warming Trays. Say goodbye to cold dishes and rushed
timing—our premium, extra-long warming mats ensure every appetizer, entree, and side stays perfectly
heated from the first guest to the last. Featuring full surface heating, precise thermostat
controls, Wanish blends professional performance with unmistakable style.

[Check details][11]

##### Precise Temperature Control

Adjust the heat with precision to keep every dish from appetizers to main courses at the ideal
serving temperature.

##### Space-Saving Foldable Design

Our unique warming trays fold or roll down compactly, making storage in any kitchen simple and
convenient.

##### Versatile & Elegant Heating

The advanced heating surface warms in seconds and is compatible with a variety of heat-safe cookware
materials.

## Choose Your Wanish Warming Tray

[[Wanish Warming Tray（Extra Large），Electric Warming Tray with Adjustable Thermostat Heating，Food
Warmer with 3 Temperature Settings,for Buffet，Gatherings，Gold]][12]

##### Wanish Electric Warming Tray with Thermostat

This Wanish Electric Warming Tray elevates any gathering with its elegant 40″L x 12″W design,
featuring sleek black heat-resistant tempered glass and premium Rose Gold edges. Utilizing
energy-efficient PTC heating technology and a safety thermostat with two temperature modes, this
extra-long mat ensures up to eight dishes stay perfectly warm for hours while offering
multi-functional use from defrosting to promoting dough fermentation.

[Check details][13]
[[Wanish Electric Warming Tray with Adjustable Thermostat Heating，Food Warmer with 3 Temperature
Settings,for Buffet，Gatherings，Gold]][14]

##### Wanish XXL Warming Tray for Parties Buffet with Tempered Glass Warming Mat for Food

The Wanish XXL Warming Tray is the ultimate centerpiece for large parties and buffets, featuring an
expansive 32”L x 18”W heat-resistant tempered glass surface that keeps 6-8 dishes warm
simultaneously. With elegant Rose Gold Stainless Steel edges and cool-touch handles, two adjustable
temperature modes, and a built-in thermostat, this sleek and safe electric mat ensures your food
remains perfectly hot while adding a touch of anti-scald luxury to your serving area.

[Check details][15]
[[Wanish Warming Tray（Extra Large），Electric Warming Tray with Adjustable Thermostat Heating，Food
Warmer with 3 Temperature Settings,for Buffet，Gatherings，Gold]][16]

##### Wanish Food Warmers with Full Surface Heating and Temperature Adjustable Gold Edges

This Wanish Extra Long Warming Tray boasts an expansive 47”L x 12”W surface, offering maximum
presentation space with its elegant heat-resistant tempered glass and premium Rose Gold edges.
Featuring full surface PTC heating and two adjustable temperature modes, this slim, safe, and
multi-functional electric warmer is perfect for keeping 6-8 dishes consistently hot during the
longest buffets or family gatherings.

[Check details][17]
[Wanish Features]

## Wanish Features

**Adjustable Temperature:** Select from multiple temperature settings to keep every type of food at
its ideal warmth for hours.

**Rapid Heating Technology:** Our advanced heating element reaches your desired temperature in
seconds, so you’re always ready to serve.

**Compact & Foldable:** After use, simply fold or roll the lightweight tray for convenient and
space-saving storage in any drawer or cabinet.

**Suits Most Cookware:** Safely place ceramic, glass, metal, and other heat-resistant cookware
directly on the warming surface.

**Easy-Wipe Surface:** The smooth, non-stick surface resists stains and messes, wiping clean
effortlessly with a damp cloth.

**Enhanced Safety:** Designed with overheating protection and non-slip feet to ensure stability and
peace of mind during use.

## Real Comfort, Real Stories

[Jessica M.]

##### Jessica M.

I bought two Wanish warming trays, and they were a total game-changer for my last dinner party! They
heated up fast and kept three to four dishes perfectly warm for hours, looking incredibly chic with
the sleek black glass and copper trim. Clean-up was a breeze, and I felt completely confident using
them even with my kids helping to serve.

[David L.]

##### David L.

The Wanish Food Warmer was the star of our Fourth of July barbecue—it added a stunning,
sophisticated touch to our buffet table. My guests couldn’t stop complimenting the elegant glass
design, which not only looked beautiful but was incredibly durable and simple to wipe clean. It
truly enhanced the festive atmosphere and helped me enjoy the celebration knowing the food was
perfect.

[Emily R.]

##### Emily R.

This warming tray is a huge hit and provides so much space for serving multiple items, blending
beautifully with my kitchen decor.

## About Wanish

##### About Us

At Wanish, we believe that elegant entertaining should be effortless. Our brand was born from a
simple need: to keep food perfectly warm at gatherings without sacrificing style or safety. We have
spent countless hours meticulously developing and improving our premium electric warming trays,
ensuring they meet the highest standards for performance and design. For example, we refined the PTC
heating technology for faster, more even heat distribution across the full surface of the tray, and
incorporated precise thermostat controls to offer both high and energy-saving low modes.
Furthermore, we dedicated significant effort to the aesthetics, finalizing the elegant,
easy-to-clean tempered glass surface and choosing the stunning Rose Gold accents to ensure our trays
are as beautiful as they are functional.

Our commitment extends beyond just superior heating performance; we strive to enhance your entire
hosting experience. We understood that size matters, which is why we offer unique dimensions like
the Extra Long 47″ x 12″ and the XXL 32″ x 18″ to fit any table or gathering size. Every detail,
from the cool-touch gold handles on our larger models to the extensive ETL safety certifications and
comprehensive one-year replacement guarantee, reflects our dedication to your peace of mind. Wanish
is here to help you focus on your guests, confident that every dish you serve will remain perfectly
warm and presented with unmistakable elegance.

##### Our History

The Wanish story began with a desire to solve a common hosting problem: how to keep buffet items
reliably warm without relying on messy candles or bulky chafing dishes. Our founders, avid
entertainers themselves, recognized a gap in the market for a product that merged professional-grade
warming technology with high-end kitchen aesthetics. From early concepts focused on maximizing
heating efficiency, we quickly iterated to develop the sleek, low-profile design featuring durable,
heat-resistant tempered glass and elegant Rose Gold accents. Our history is defined by this
dedication to innovation—from adopting the latest PTC heating film technology to launching our
unique, extra-long warming tray dimensions—all driven by the singular goal of providing hosts with
stylish, safe, and effective tools for effortless, perfect gatherings.

## Stay Connected with Wanish

Join our community to receive exclusive offers, new product announcements, and expert tips for
flawless hosting.

timing—our premium, extra-long warming mats ensure every appetizer, entree, and side stays perfectly
heated from the first guest to the last. Featuring full surface heating, precise thermostat
controls, Wanish blends professional performance with unmistakable style.

[Check details][11]

##### Precise Temperature Control

Adjust the heat with precision to keep every dish from appetizers to main courses at the ideal
serving temperature.

##### Space-Saving Foldable Design

Our unique warming trays fold or roll down compactly, making storage in any kitchen simple and
convenient.

##### Versatile & Elegant Heating

The advanced heating surface warms in seconds and is compatible with a variety of heat-safe cookware
materials.

## Choose Your Wanish Warming Tray

[[Wanish Warming Tray（Extra Large），Electric Warming Tray with Adjustable Thermostat Heating，Food
Warmer with 3 Temperature Settings,for Buffet，Gatherings，Gold]][12]

##### Wanish Electric Warming Tray with Thermostat

This Wanish Electric Warming Tray elevates any gathering with its elegant 40″L x 12″W design,
featuring sleek black heat-resistant tempered glass and premium Rose Gold edges. Utilizing
energy-efficient PTC heating technology and a safety thermostat with two temperature modes, this
extra-long mat ensures up to eight dishes stay perfectly warm for hours while offering
multi-functional use from defrosting to promoting dough fermentation.

[Check details][13]
[[Wanish Electric Warming Tray with Adjustable Thermostat Heating，Food Warmer with 3 Temperature
Settings,for Buffet，Gatherings，Gold]][14]

##### Wanish XXL Warming Tray for Parties Buffet with Tempered Glass Warming Mat for Food

The Wanish XXL Warming Tray is the ultimate centerpiece for large parties and buffets, featuring an
expansive 32”L x 18”W heat-resistant tempered glass surface that keeps 6-8 dishes warm
simultaneously. With elegant Rose Gold Stainless Steel edges and cool-touch handles, two adjustable
temperature modes, and a built-in thermostat, this sleek and safe electric mat ensures your food
remains perfectly hot while adding a touch of anti-scald luxury to your serving area.

[Check details][15]
[[Wanish Warming Tray（Extra Large），Electric Warming Tray with Adjustable Thermostat Heating，Food
Warmer with 3 Temperature Settings,for Buffet，Gatherings，Gold]][16]

##### Wanish Food Warmers with Full Surface Heating and Temperature Adjustable Gold Edges

This Wanish Extra Long Warming Tray boasts an expansive 47”L x 12”W surface, offering maximum
presentation space with its elegant heat-resistant tempered glass and premium Rose Gold edges.
Featuring full surface PTC heating and two adjustable temperature modes, this slim, safe, and
multi-functional electric warmer is perfect for keeping 6-8 dishes consistently hot during the
longest buffets or family gatherings.

[Check details][17]
[Wanish Features]

## Wanish Features

**Adjustable Temperature:** Select from multiple temperature settings to keep every type of food at
its ideal warmth for hours.

**Rapid Heating Technology:** Our advanced heating element reaches your desired temperature in
seconds, so you’re always ready to serve.

**Compact & Foldable:** After use, simply fold or roll the lightweight tray for convenient and
space-saving storage in any drawer or cabinet.

**Suits Most Cookware:** Safely place ceramic, glass, metal, and other heat-resistant cookware
directly on the warming surface.

**Easy-Wipe Surface:** The smooth, non-stick surface resists stains and messes, wiping clean
effortlessly with a damp cloth.

**Enhanced Safety:** Designed with overheating protection and non-slip feet to ensure stability and
peace of mind during use.

## Real Comfort, Real Stories

[Jessica M.]

##### Jessica M.

I bought two Wanish warming trays, and they were a total game-changer for my last dinner party! They
heated up fast and kept three to four dishes perfectly warm for hours, looking incredibly chic with
the sleek black glass and copper trim. Clean-up was a breeze, and I felt completely confident using
them even with my kids helping to serve.

[David L.]

##### David L.

The Wanish Food Warmer was the star of our Fourth of July barbecue—it added a stunning,
sophisticated touch to our buffet table. My guests couldn’t stop complimenting the elegant glass
design, which not only looked beautiful but was incredibly durable and simple to wipe clean. It
truly enhanced the festive atmosphere and helped me enjoy the celebration knowing the food was
perfect.

[Emily R.]

##### Emily R.

This warming tray is a huge hit and provides so much space for serving multiple items, blending
beautifully with my kitchen decor. It flawlessly keeps everything at the right temperature, making
it easy to focus on entertaining instead of worrying about cold food. Although it’s large, I
appreciate the slim profile that makes storage simple; I just slide it right under my bed when not
in use!

## About Wanish

##### About Us

At Wanish, we believe that elegant entertaining should be effortless. Our brand was born from a
simple need: to keep food perfectly warm at gatherings without sacrificing style or safety. We have
spent countless hours meticulously developing and improving our premium electric warming trays,
ensuring they meet the highest standards for performance and design. For example, we refined the PTC
heating technology for faster, more even heat distribution across the full surface of the tray, and
incorporated precise thermostat controls to offer both high and energy-saving low modes.
Furthermore, we dedicated significant effort to the aesthetics, finalizing the elegant,
easy-to-clean tempered glass surface and choosing the stunning Rose Gold accents to ensure our trays
are as beautiful as they are functional.

Our commitment extends beyond just superior heating performance; we strive to enhance your entire
hosting experience. We understood that size matters, which is why we offer unique dimensions like
the Extra Long 47″ x 12″ and the XXL 32″ x 18″ to fit any table or gathering size. Every detail,
from the cool-touch gold handles on our larger models to the extensive ETL safety certifications and
comprehensive one-year replacement guarantee, reflects our dedication to your peace of mind. Wanish
is here to help you focus on your guests, confident that every dish you serve will remain perfectly
warm and presented with unmistakable elegance.

##### Our History

The Wanish story began with a desire to solve a common hosting problem: how to keep buffet items
reliably warm without relying on messy candles or bulky chafing dishes. Our founders, avid
entertainers themselves, recognized a gap in the market for a product that merged professional-grade
warming technology with high-end kitchen aesthetics. From early concepts focused on maximizing
heating efficiency, we quickly iterated to develop the sleek, low-profile design featuring durable,
heat-resistant tempered glass and elegant Rose Gold accents. Our history is defined by this
dedication to innovation—from adopting the latest PTC heating film technology to launching our
unique, extra-long warming tray dimensions—all driven by the singular goal of providing hosts with
stylish, safe, and effective tools for effortless, perfect gatherings.

## About United Foam & Mattress

## **Profile**


In the wake of the immense shortage of conventional resources, it is evident to make use of quality
materials. In this aspect, we United Foam and Mattress Industries Pvt. Ltd., established in 2071
B.S. are engaged in Manufacturing, Supplying and Exporting a wide range of Foam, Mattress and
Pillows. The wide assortment of products offered by us includes LD Foam, HD Foam, SHDL Foam, 32 D
Foam, 40 D Foam, 50 D Foam, 60 D Foam, Soft Foam, HR Foam, Spring Mattress, Rebonded Mattress, Coir
Mattress,  Foam Mattress, EPE Mattress, Pillows, Cushion, Blankets, Quilting and lot more. The
entire range of products are designed and developed in line with the prevailing trends and standards
of our industry. We take into account the variegated tastes and preferences of our national and
international clients and offer improvised range of products. With the active support of our 30+
employees who are professionals on their positions, we are able to offer flawless range of products,
at reasonable price range. Thus, we are greatly admired in the global market segments.

With our high-tech manufacturing unit, we are able to manufacture a wide range of Foam, Mattress and
Pillows Products. The products are highly appreciated for their renowned features such as
durability, attractive looks and high comfort level offered by them. These products are extensively
used for residential as well as commercial purposes; we are able to gain a good position in the
national and international arena.

### 
### **Quality****
### **
### **Quality Control**

Our company is able to reach great heights of success due to our total quality approach. Thus, we
commit ourselves to offer only the best quality range of Foam, Mattress and Pillows. For this
purpose, we have set up a fully equipped quality control unit in our facility. It is equipped with
various tools and equipment to conduct various quality tests. Our highly experienced and
professional quality controllers administer these tests based on the national and international
quality parameters set by of our industry. These products are tested on the following quality norms:


*Reliability*

*Manufacturing*

*Techniques*

*Durability*

*Utility*

*Client Satisfaction*


The major objective of our company is to understand the diverse requirements of our clients and
offer suitable range of Products. With the active support of our team of diligent experts, we are
able to offer innovative range of products that fulfils all the needs of our clients; we are able to
gain the maximum level of satisfaction of our clients. With our timely and prompt delivery
schedules, we are able to meet the deadlines of our orders within the stipulated time frame.

### Product Info

What sizes or specifications do your products come in?
All our EVA/EPE inserts are custom-made based on your product size, structure, and packaging
requirements. There are no fixed sizes.
Can you customize irregular or complex shapes?
Yes, we specialize in custom-shaped inserts tailored to your product. We support various processes
like die cutting, slotting, hot pressing, and flocking.
What’s the difference between EVA and EPE materials?
EVA is denser and more pressure-resistant, ideal for premium packaging. EPE is lighter and more
elastic, suitable for e-commerce shipping. We’ll recommend the best material based on your needs.

Creative Building Fun for Kids: Safe & Colorful DIY Foam Blocks
This client is a toy company focused on educational products for children. They were launching a new
DIY building toy set and needed safe, colorful, and durable foam components suitable for kids aged
3–8. We customized a set of EVA/EPE foam blocks in various shapes (cubes, trapezoids, etc.) and
vibrant colors. The foam is soft to the touch, odorless, and compliant with toy safety standards. We
also provided a matching insert and packaging box to organize the pieces and enhance shelf appeal.
Premium Packaging for Pour-Over Coffee Gear
This client is a European brand launching a premium pour-over coffee set. They needed protective and
elegant packaging for glass and metal components during international shipping. We customized a
high-density black EVA insert with precise cutouts for the kettle, dripper, and accessories. The
foam is shock-absorbing, durable, and fits each item securely. We also provided a rigid box design
to match the product’s minimalist aesthetic and enhance the unboxing experience and retail display.
Protective Packaging for Premium Faucet Sets
This client is a bathroom brand targeting the Southeast Asian market, launching a multi-piece faucet
set that required strong protection and efficient packaging for export.We customized a high-density
EPE foam insert with precise cutouts to secure each metal component, offering shock resistance and
scratch protection during transit.The outer packaging is a rigid corrugated box with a lift-off lid,
designed for stacking, container loading, and brand presentation.
Custom Foam Inserts for High-Precision Devices
This client specializes in high-precision measuring and testing instruments, which feature complex
structures and require excellent shock protection during transit.We used black high-resilience
sponge foam to create a custom-cut insert that securely holds each component in place, minimizing
movement and impact.The soft and flexible foam is ideal for safeguarding delicate electronic parts,
balancing functionality with a professional presentation.
Refined Protection for Premium Bathroom Fixtures
This client is a premium bathroom brand launching a concealed shower set, with elevated expectations
for both aesthetics and a luxurious unboxing experience.We created a white high-density EVA insert,
covered with a layer of light gray velvet fabric to enhance the visual appeal and prevent scratches
on the metal components.The insert was precisely cut to fit the shower head and accessories,
ensuring both secure transport and a refined product presentation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Product Info

What sizes or specifications do your products come in?
All our EVA/EPE inserts are custom-made based on your product size, structure, and packaging
requirements. There are no fixed sizes.
Can you customize irregular or complex shapes?
Yes, we specialize in custom-shaped inserts tailored to your product. We support various processes
like die cutting, slotting, hot pressing, and flocking.
What’s the difference between EVA and EPE materials?
EVA is denser and more pressure-resistant, ideal for premium packaging. EPE is lighter and more
elastic, suitable for e-commerce shipping. We’ll recommend the best material based on your needs.

### Sampling & Production

Do you offer samples? How long does it take?
Yes, we offer samples. Standard samples take 2–3 days; complex designs may take up to 5 days.
What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
Our typical MOQ is 100 sets, but it may vary depending on the design and materials. Please contact
us for details.
